name: bare-bones
description: Drop a spreadsheet. Share an explorer. A skeleton for in-browser data explorers.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bare-bones/nonprofit-budget build && pnpm --filter @bare-bones/club-results build && pnpm --filter @bare-bones/skeleton build && node tools/metrics.mjs && pnpm --filter @bare-bones/site build
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p skeleton/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/nonprofit-budget/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/club-results/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: node tools/verify.mjs && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && vitest run && node tools/budget.mjs && node tools/guard.mjs
